title: Notification created for catalog events with correct recipient + deep link
objective: Verify catalog events (assignment to custodian, overdue return, approval requested/decided, stocktake opened/due, warranty expiring, maintenance due, exception reported) create in-app notifications for the correct recipients with title/body/link.
preconditions: Notification system delivered; ability to trigger at least 3 catalog events (assign asset to employee; create approval request; overdue assignment fixture).
test_data: assignment to employee E; approval request for approver A; overdue assignment fixture
steps: Trigger each event.
GET /api/v1/notifications as the expected recipient; verify entry (type, title, body, link, read_at null, created_at UTC).
GET /notifications as an unrelated user; verify absence.
expected_result: Each event notifies exactly the documented recipients (no fan-out leakage); link points to an authorized deep link (asset/approval/stocktake detail); payload contains no sensitive data beyond the recipient's permission.

title: Dedupe — repeated identical events do not spam unread duplicates
objective: Verify the dedupe_key partial-unique mechanism (unique where read_at IS NULL): repeating the same event for the same recipient updates/reuses the unread notification instead of stacking duplicates.
preconditions: An event type that can fire repeatedly (e.g., overdue evaluation or repeated exception reports).
test_data: trigger same event twice for recipient R
steps: Trigger event; count R's unread notifications of that type.
Trigger the identical event again; recount.
Mark read; retrigger; verify a new notification may now be created.
expected_result: Unread duplicates prevented (count stable or documented refresh behavior); after read, a new occurrence creates a fresh entry; no unique-constraint 500s under concurrent triggers.

title: Mark-as-read and read state isolation between users
objective: Verify POST /notifications/:uuid/read sets read_at for the owner only; other users get 404; read state does not affect the dedupe slot of other recipients.
preconditions: Recipient R with unread notification N; another user U.
test_data: read request on N by R and by U
steps: As U: POST read on N → expect 404 (or 403 per contract; record).
As R: POST read → 200/204; GET list shows read_at set.
Re-POST read (idempotency) → stable response.
expected_result: Ownership enforced; read_at persisted (UTC); repeat read idempotent; unread count endpoints/badges consistent after read.

title: Preferences — optional notifications disableable; mandatory compliance non-disableable
objective: Verify GET/PATCH /notifications/preferences: users can disable optional event types and no longer receive them, while mandatory compliance types cannot be disabled (400/ignored per contract) and still arrive.
preconditions: Preference catalog delivered; user U with default prefs.
test_data: PATCH disable optional type 'warranty_expiring'; PATCH attempt disable mandatory type (per catalog)
steps: GET preferences — record catalog with mandatory/optional flags.
Disable an optional type; trigger its event; verify no notification to U.
Attempt to disable a mandatory type; verify rejection or documented ignore; trigger event; verify notification still arrives.
Re-enable optional type; trigger; verify delivery resumes.
expected_result: Optional suppression effective; mandatory enforcement per spec (non-disableable); preference changes take effect without admin; prefs scoped per user.

title: Email dispatch when SMTP configured; failures logged without confidential content
objective: Verify that with SMTP configured, notifications also dispatch email (documented types); with SMTP failure, the in-app notification is retained and the failure is logged without confidential content (no credentials/body secrets).
preconditions: SMTP stub (e.g., local debug server or documented test backend) OR documented eager/console email backend in test settings.
test_data: trigger notifiable event with email enabled; then with SMTP broken/misconfigured
steps: Trigger event with working SMTP config; verify email captured by stub (recipient, subject, no sensitive over-disclosure).
Break SMTP (bad host); retrigger; verify in-app notification still created and failure logged (inspect log record: no password/secret, no full confidential body).
expected_result: Email sent only when configured; failure degrades gracefully (in-app retained, logged with correlation ID); logs mask credentials and confidential content per §13; if SMTP testing is impossible in QA env → MANUAL with the stub procedure documented.
automation_status: automatable where SMTP stub available; else MANUAL

title: Deep links are authorization-checked on click-through
objective: Verify notification deep links land on the target only when the clicking user still has permission; revoked/out-of-scope targets redirect to 403/404 UX, never leak data.
preconditions: Notification with deep link to asset X for user R; then rescope R (or use a user who received a stale link).
test_data: deep link URL from notification payload
steps: API: GET the deep-link target as authorized R → 200.
After permission change (or as a different user): GET target → 404/403.
UI (if browser available): click link in notification center; verify re-auth + landing behavior.
expected_result: Links never bypass authorization; revoked access yields safe 403/404 handling; no stale data rendered client-side.
automation_status: API part automatable; UI part Playwright

title: E2E — notification center: list, unread badge, mark read, preferences UI
objective: UI journey: trigger a notification (assign asset to signed-in employee), see unread badge on bell, open /notifications, mark read (badge clears), adjust a preference toggle.
preconditions: Full stack; Playwright; operator + employee credentials.
steps: As operator: assign asset to employee E.
As E: verify bell unread count; open center; verify entry content + link.
Mark read; verify badge clears without reload errors.
Open preferences; toggle an optional type off/on; verify persistence after reload.
expected_result: Center matches API truth; badge/count live updates via accessible live region; preferences persist; keyboard operable; evidence captured. (Browser-unavailable → BLOCKED.)
